content:
You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

Not everyone should be obliged to pay the TV & radio licence. Particularly the younger generations are no longer dependent on the programming of public broadcasters. US series are preferred over “Tatort”, and online magazines are turned to instead of the “Tagesthemen”. The TV & radio licence enables economically independent journalism. But as long as the licence payers have no say in the distribution of the funds, the fee quite rightly annoys them.
What argument components exists in sentence " US series are preferred over “Tatort”, and online magazines are turned to instead of the “Tagesthemen”" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.
<pro>US series are preferred over “Tatort”,</pro> <pro>and online magazines are turned to instead of the “Tagesthemen”</pro>
